method: same ToposImageCodec binding and native library; full decode versus tc_image_decode_preview target-size reconstruction
interpretation: The 1024x540 target path reduced measured subprocess peak RSS by about 40% versus full decode.
Target-size decode still parses and CRC-checks every compressed slice.

A 2048x1080 target is not guaranteed to be faster because sampled scalar reconstruction can lose to full-block SIMD at modest reduction factors; a separate in-process sweep measured about 31.9 ms at 512x270.
This is a 4K proxy measurement; it is not evidence of a specific 8K or 12K FPS.
